name: How do I choose a contractor for walker-friendly home modifications?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for walker-friendly home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for walker-friendly home modifications, look for one with specific experience in accessible design and universal modifications. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references from previous clients who had similar work done. A good contractor should be knowledgeable about ADA guidelines and local building codes, and offer a detailed consultation to understand your needs. They should also provide a clear, itemized quote and communicate effectively throughout the project. City Dweller, LLC specializes in these types of modifications.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible design, check their license and insurance, review references, and ensure they provide clear quotes and communication.
